title: The sprint run's worker brief and land agree on who frees a finished worker's worktree
goal: the headless brief and kb/_self/backlog.md say one thing about a finished worker's worktree (land removes it; the worker detaches only while land cannot), checked by a test that the brief's step and the runbook's step name the same command; found by the first supervised run (ST-opjydjc3): the runner could not remove the worktree itself (agents' shells may not run git worktree remove) so it spent a message round trip asking the worker to detach, and the clone kept the agent-* worktree after landing
